Mum had a COPD and blood pressure review booked for today.
When we arrived, I used the screen to book her in. It wouldn't allow me to do so. This is very poor. Mum is nearly 82 years of age. She has lots of health issues including alzheimer's disease.  She gets very upset about any visit to the surgery. I had to get her ready and into the surgery in her wheelchair.  The weather on this day was appalling.  Strong winds and heavy rain. Mum doesn't need this and she and I, will have to go through this all again when we have a rescheduled appointment in two weeks time. Notice it is a fortnight, not sooner. A poor show all round from BHF Goldthorpe.
